answer: On this Linux worktree (Linux) the program's declared Windows rails are MCPAgentMailSupervisor (8812), BasicMemory-HTTP-MCP (8765), their watchdogs, ClaudeScienceWatchdog/Maintain, World-Watch, Resource-Guard, RAM-Keeper, MCP-Orphan-Reaper, and RecallIndexRebuild. Windows scheduled-task APIs are absent; Linux systemd matching units=0; live TCP listeners do not include 8812, 8765, or 8000. Probe 2 measured 0 up / 5 down declared endpoints. Wrong-port control failed as required; a scratch listener on an ephemeral port made the same health probe succeed, so the detector is non-vacuous in both states. A task listed Running whose endpoint refuses connections is the catalog finding: here there is no Running Windows task to trust, and every declared endpoint refuses, so the rails are not live on this host. Recovery was not observed (no watchdog process).
